before: A picture bullet drew at its authored shape size times a marker-size scale, so a bullet authored at a large image's size could be taller than the page.
after: A picture bullet measures its authored shape height against the image pixel height before the marker-size scale. Shared document state and operations are unchanged.
reason: The change is confined to layout. Replicas compute the same layout from the same tree and package, and saved documents keep the same XML.
